prompt: Summarise the GST-Rab pulldown assay in bullet points
judge_reasoning: Candidate 1 directly summarizes the GST-Rab pulldown assay with a clear, stepwise procedure and appropriate readout (SDS-PAGE/Western), matching the prompt’s focus. Candidate 2 includes a correct description of the GST-Rab pulldown but wastes substantial space on an unrequested comparison to Co-IP, reducing focus on the requested “assay summary.” Candidate 3 mostly discusses cancer applications and does not meaningfully summarize how the GST-Rab pulldown is performed. Candidate 4 is largely a general overview of Rab proteins and unrelated assay types, with little/no specific content about the GST-Rab pulldown workflow.
